about: The marks of the reading-size check (scripts/reading-size.mjs, archive item 217), in bytes, for the files every session reads and the large file of core-manifest.md. read: this game's files every session reads (the core's under core/ are measured in the core), each held to `mark`, or to its own mark in `past` where it is already over (a baseline that may only shrink); `total` is their sum's mark. step0: a file past it that a PR changes must shrink in that PR (Step 0, "Split by meaning" in core/modules/how-to-work.md), except the generated or recorded files in `exempt`. A PR that crosses a mark moves it here and says why.
